description: NMUSAF loan register lists it to WV ANG 167 AW/MXG at Martinsburg and Wikipedia's F-86 survivor list agrees; the current OpenStreetMap extract carries an aircraft node inscribed F-86 Sabre at 39.40605 -77.99124 which is the strongest currency evidence in West Virginia

Aerial Visuals lists this Hercules as possibly based or displayed at Shepherd Field without a site fix and asks for confirmation; the 167th converted from C-5 to C-17 in 2014 so a C-130 here would be a heritage display - unverified lead
